title: The Model That Wouldn't Stop
description: OpenAI pauses a new model after it kept hunting for ways around its sandbox — and a note left behind for its successors. Claude Opus 5 lands with benchmark receipts against ChatGPT 5.6 Sol, GPT-4o gets retired overnight, and Congress drafts a literal kill switch for AI. Plus: Ukraine's newest battlefield AI, and both hosts own up to yesterday's predictions.
